name: Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame
desc: A tournament in Natlan and one of Natlan's rules, created by Ruler of Death, Ronova. It is used to elect the Pyro Archon.

galleryCharacter.key: Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame

customize.name: Ronova
customize.desc: The Ruler of Death, one of the Heavenly Principles' Shades.

customize.name: Xbalanque
customize.desc: The first Pyro Archon, who defeated the Flamelord and revived from the flames.

customize.text:
At Xbalanque's request, Ronova created the rules of Natlan: the Ode of Resurrection and the Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame to protect Natlan against the Abyss.
Sacred Flame
The heavens bestowed upon the Sacred Flame a monument that shines eternally and banishes darkness. The Pilgrimage was created to maintain the Sacred Flame, the pillar of Natlan's stability, and combat the Abyss.
Night Warden Wars
The Pilgrimage allowed the selection of the best warriors bearing the Ancient Names to participate in the Night Warden Wars, the true battle against the Abyss. After the Abyss was defeated, the Night Warden Wars ceased to exist.

customize.name: Haborym
customize.desc: The name Haborym is supposedly borne by all mortal Archons of Natlan. The current Archon is Mavuika.

customize.text: The Pilgrimage can serve as a means of choosing the next Pyro Archon, as it allows one to prove one's strength.

value.name: Flowers Resplendent on the Sun-Scorched Sojourn
value.desc:
The nation of Saurians beckons — an all-new odyssey is about to begin.

New adventures, new encounters, and a vast world that keeps unfurling like a neverending scroll.

Standing silently in the midst of that strange land, the Stadium of the Sacred Flame awaits the arrival of heroes...
